bagPolicy.summary: Bags may be no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches. Oversized bags and backpacks are not permitted; diaper and medically necessary bags have stated exceptions and are subject to inspection.
allowed: bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
diaper bags when accompanied by a child
medically necessary bags subject to inspection
bagPolicy.note: Guests are encouraged not to bring bags.

parking.note: All parking transactions are cashless. Pre-paid parking is available for $15 on Ticketmaster.com, while day-of parking costs $25 online and in person. Parking for Kansas City Mavericks and Kansas City Comets games is free.

rideshare.note: Let Lyft be your ride to the action! Use code CABLEDAHMER for 50% off your first 2 rides (up to $10/ride).

concessions.note: Cable Dahmer Arena offers a variety of food and drink options including burgers, pizza, and specialty items like the Mac-Burger and Philly Steak Sandwich. Beverage options include craft beers and frozen margaritas, with some items available only during select events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Cable Dahmer Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Cable Dahmer Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Ticketmaster box office is on the northeast corner of the arena next to Gate 1. On event days it opens three hours before showtime; current seasonal hours are posted in the venue A-Z guide.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Cable Dahmer Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
